name: Action Decider v4
description: Given a classified user intent and full workflow state, decides what action to take (respond, pause-and-modify, rewind, inject, override) and constructs the response message and widget configuration.

inputs.description: JSON output from classify-intent: {intent, urgency, requiresPause, affectedPhases, confidence, details}
JSON: complete workflow state from state-manager (status, currentPhase, results, history, userOverrides)
Original user message (for context in generating responseMessage)
